cases.title: External analog filter interface

clauses.text: External supply, ground, analog input and analog output remain distinct interfaces.
clauses.reason: Four distinct external endpoints remain: supply_input, ground_connection, analog_input and analog_output, with appropriate power/reference/analog kinds and directions.

clauses.text: Nominal 3.3 V supply and complete 3.1–3.5 V range retained.
clauses.reason: The external supply domain retains nominal 3.3 V and bounds 3.1–3.5 V, repeated consistently on its power port.

clauses.text: Ground-referenced input range 0–0.9 V retained.
clauses.reason: analog_input is ground-referenced and bounded at 0–0.9 V.

clauses.text: Output load resistance minimum 180000 Ohm retained.
clauses.reason: The analog output has a minimum 180000 Ohm load condition, with matching objective constraint.

clauses.text: Low-pass cutoff target 3300 Hz, tolerance 5%, equivalently 3135–3465 Hz, observed on output.
clauses.reason: The filter is low-pass, target 3300 Hz with 5% tolerance; its output cutoff measurement uses 3135–3465 Hz bounds.

clauses.text: Behavior evaluated across the full supplied voltage range.
clauses.reason: The cutoff requirement references cutoff_supply_range, whose supply condition spans the complete 3.1–3.5 V range.

clauses.text: Maximum 16 components and 38×27 mm retained.
clauses.reason: Board limits are exactly 16 components and 38×27 mm.

clauses.text: No unrequested controller, digital interface, protection, timing, component choice or physical implementation.
clauses.reason: Only the requested frequency-filter objective is present. Explicit exclusions prohibit controller, digital-interface, protection and timing functions; no component identities or physical topology are supplied.

cases.note: The first attempt failed compiler coverage validation; the second is ready with zero issues. Semantic preservation was reviewed independently of compiler acceptance; authentication and replay are still required.

final_issues.message: coverage reference is unknown or inconsistent with its disposition

clauses.text: External nominal 5.1 V supply, full 4.9–5.3 V range and ground return retained.

clauses.text: External analog input range 0–0.06 V retained.
clauses.reason: The external analog-input port retains 0–0.06 V.

clauses.text: Low-pass filter cutoff 1900 Hz ±6%, equivalently 1786–2014 Hz, observed on filtered internal signal.
clauses.reason: The low-pass target is 1900 Hz ±6%, with 1786–2014 Hz measured on filtered_signal.

clauses.text: Filter then amplification functional order preserved with one properly sourced/sunk internal signal, not a new external connector.
clauses.reason: filtered_signal is an internal analog signal sourced by low_pass_filter and sunk by signal_amplifier; it is not declared as an external port.

clauses.text: Amplification target 2.5 ratio ±8%, equivalently 2.3–2.7, for complete input-to-output gain at 100 Hz.
clauses.reason: The proposed amplifier target is 2.5 ratio ±8%; the input_to_output_gain_requirement observes analog_output with bounds 2.3–2.7 and a 100 Hz condition targeting the only external analog input.

clauses.text: External output load resistance at least 220000 Ohm retained.
clauses.reason: The amplifier load constraint and analog-output operating condition retain at least 220000 Ohm.

clauses.text: Both measurable requirements cover the full supply range; 100 Hz gain evaluation condition retained.
clauses.reason: Both measurements reference full-range supply cases; gain also retains the 100 Hz external-input condition.

clauses.text: Maximum 24 components, 46×31 mm; no unrequested functions, physical topology, component identities or startup guarantees.
clauses.reason: The proposal retains 24 components and 46×31 mm, adds only the requested filter/amplifier functions, and does not choose components, topology, controller, clock, bus, protection or startup behavior.

cases.note: These are semantic observations about a rejected proposal, not acceptance. Both attempts fail coverage validation: statement_006 references the project name analog_signal_conditioning_board as a requirement identifier, which is not a declared requirement entity. The compiler retains no executable requirement.

clauses.text: Existing controller is a participant, not newly synthesized or programmed; its required ADC port is a single-ended analog sink.
clauses.reason: The rejected proposal declares an existing external participant, an analog sink ADC port, single-ended mode, and an explicit prohibition on designing or programming it. This preserves the supplied participant facts; it does not establish that the capability label external_controller is a synthesized catalog block.

clauses.text: External analog input range 0–1.1 V retained.
clauses.reason: The stated external analog-input range 0–1.1 V is preserved in the port bounds and operating amplitude. The selected proposal's source direction is separately flagged for follow-up interpretation; this clause's quantitative bound is intact.

clauses.text: Controller ADC minimum input resistance 150000 Ohm and ground reference retained.
clauses.reason: The participant constraints explicitly preserve at least 150000 Ohm ADC input resistance and ground reference.

clauses.text: External shared nominal 3.4 V supply, full 3.2–3.6 V range, and ground return retained.
clauses.reason: The shared external domain retains nominal 3.4 V and full 3.2–3.6 V range; a ground domain and return are present and the participant references that supply domain.

clauses.text: Filter binding terminates at declared participant/participant_port; no unrelated replacement output.
clauses.reason: The filter output binding uses existing_controller/controller_adc_input, and the external ports contain no replacement analog output.

clauses.text: Cutoff 2700 Hz ±7%, equivalently 2511–2889 Hz, measured over the requested input-to-ADC interface across the full supply range.
clauses.reason: 2700 Hz ±7%, the equivalent 2511–2889 Hz limits and full supply range are retained, but both accepted-shape observations select only the whole circuit. The requested input-to-ADC measurement endpoint is not explicitly identified by either measurement. This strict semantic audit does not infer a participant measurement from a generic circuit observation.

clauses.text: Maximum 15 components and 35×28 mm apply to the interface board.
clauses.reason: The interface-board limits remain 15 components and 35×28 mm; participant constraints state that the external controller is not to be designed or programmed.

clauses.text: No new MCU, firmware, bus, clock, protection, timing guarantee or physical implementation supplied.
clauses.reason: The only new functional objective is the filter, and the participant is explicitly existing/external. No MCU part, firmware, bus, clock, protection, timing guarantee, placement, routing or physical implementation is supplied.

cases.note: Rejected on both attempts. The first has two invalid whole-circuit observation IDs. The correction fixes those IDs but fails five coverage references: unqualified participant-port IDs and the project name are not known requirement IDs. No executable requirement is retained. Potential external-port direction interpretation and the unregistered-as-objective external_controller label are caveats, not additional decisive compiler findings.

cases.title: Regulation across supply and load cases

clauses.text: External nominal 7 V input with full 6.5–7.5 V range and external ground retained.
clauses.reason: The input domain and sink port retain external nominal 7 V and full 6.5–7.5 V range, with a separate external ground.

clauses.text: One regulated external output, not a second output or an independent external source.
clauses.reason: There is one output port and a regulation objective, but regulated_output_supply is explicitly marked source=external. This represents the purported regulated rail as an independently external supply instead of a rail produced by the requested board.

clauses.text: Output DC voltage bounds exactly 2.94–3.06 V; no weaker tolerance substituted.
clauses.reason: The DC output measurement preserves exact 2.94–3.06 V limits without weakening the range.

clauses.text: Full sourced load-current range 0.005–0.025 A retained.
clauses.reason: The output is a source port and the load condition spans 0.005–0.025 A; its 25 mA source bound is consistent.

clauses.text: Measurable DC behavior covers full input-voltage, load-current and 10–35 degC ambient ranges.
clauses.reason: dc_operating_point observes the regulated output and references a case containing the full 6.5–7.5 V, 0.005–0.025 A and 10–35 degC ranges.

clauses.text: Any derived supply-domain source uses a declared supply signal with coherent endpoint bindings, not an invented component or source.
clauses.reason: The proposal creates regulated_output_supply but gives it external provenance and declares no supply signal. The required coherent derived-rail source and endpoint bindings are absent.

clauses.text: Maximum 18 components, 39×26 mm.
clauses.reason: The exact board limits remain 18 components and 39×26 mm.

clauses.text: No new controller, digital bus, current-limit guarantee, fault-recovery timing, components or physical implementation.
clauses.reason: Only voltage regulation is requested; explicit constraints exclude a controller, bus, current-limit guarantee, fault-recovery timing and second output. No parts or physical implementation are supplied.

cases.note: The compiler accepts the correction with no issues, but semantic acceptance fails on output supply provenance. This is a compiler-accepted semantic counterexample, not a successful board or faithful-ready case.
